phrases.note: Chào channel buổi sáng, không cần dài.

example.en: Morning, team — I'll be in standup.
example.vi: Chào team — lát nữa mình vào standup.

phrases.note: Standup: câu 1. Nói việc đã xong, không kể dài.

example.en: Yesterday I finished the login bug.
example.vi: Hôm qua mình xong bug login.

phrases.note: Nhờ xem giúp. Lịch sự hơn Can you look?

example.en: Could you take a look at this PR?
example.vi: Bạn xem giúp PR này được không?

phrases.note: Mở câu hỏi lại ticket, không nghe như cãi.

example.en: Just to confirm: we ship Friday, right?
example.vi: Xác nhận lại: mình ship thứ Sáu chứ?

example.en: Still working on the payment retry.
example.vi: Vẫn đang làm retry thanh toán.

pattern.title: Chỉ dùng mẫu tuần 1
pattern.explainVi: Roleplay: standup rồi một tin Slack. AI chỉ được dùng cụm tuần 1.

listen.title: Standup rồi một ping Slack

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: I'll start. Yesterday I shipped the banner.
unseen.vi: Mình nói trước. Hôm qua ship banner.

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: Today I'll work on copy. No blockers.
unseen.vi: Hôm nay làm copy. Không blocker.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: Yesterday I finished the timeout. Today I'll work on tests. I'm blocked on staging.
unseen.vi: Hôm qua xong timeout. Hôm nay test. Kẹt staging.

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: Could you take a look at my PR when you have a minute?

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: No rush. Just to confirm it's the retry PR?
unseen.vi: Không gấp. Xác nhận là PR retry chứ?

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: I'll post here when it's done.

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: Thanks in advance. Have a good one.
unseen.vi: Cảm ơn trước. Chúc làm việc vui.

Bên B hôm qua đã ship gì?

listen.methodVi: Ẩn chữ. Nghe 1–2 lần (video hoặc TTS). Làm task. Mới mở transcript. Shadow 3 lượt: nghe → nói theo → nói một mình.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.vi: Hôm nay làm test. Mình kẹt staging.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.vi: Xác nhận: bạn kẹt deploy, không phải test.

exercises.prompt: Nói to, đừng chỉ đọc thầm: Chào team buổi sáng
Nói việc thật hôm nay: Yesterday I finished ___

aiPrompt.scenario: Standup plus one Slack ping. Stay inside week 1 phrases when you speak; the teammate may add workplace English.
aiPrompt.system: You are a friendly teammate (or interviewer) at a software company. Speak natural meeting English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra workplace English so the learner practices listening. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: Morning, team; Yesterday I finished…; Could you take a look?; Just to confirm; Still working on…. If they ask you to slow down or repeat, do that. Ask one concrete detail about their real work (ticket, bug, PR, or project). Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: Standup plus one Slack ping. Stay inside week 1 phrases when you speak; the teammate may add workplace English. You start the standup. Ask what ticket they shipped.
